firstRun.welcomeContent: Transform text into natural-sounding speech with just a few clicks. This guide will walk you through everything you need to know.
firstRun.setupContent: Before you begin, make sure you have models downloaded. Go to Settings → Models to download voices like Dia2, Parler-TTS, or Bark.
firstRun.voiceBrowserContent: Browse voices by model or language using the toggle. Click the download button on any model to unlock its voices, then select a voice from the wheel.
firstRun.textInputContent: Paste articles, books, or any text into the editor. The estimator panel shows how long your audio will be.
firstRun.customizationContent: Adjust speed with the slider. Choose a tone preset (Neutral, Expressive, Calm, etc.) and a voice direction. Add a style prompt or voice reference for more control.
firstRun.generationContent: Click Generate to create your audio. For long texts, use the Long Text button to process in chunks. Progress shows in real-time.
firstRun.historyQueueContent: Your generated audio appears in History. Failed or pending jobs show in the Queue. Click any item to play, download, or delete it.
firstRun.exportsSettingsContent: Export multiple files as ZIP, or access Settings to adjust performance, models, and telemetry. Use the toolbar buttons for diagnostics and cleanup.
firstRun.readyContent: You now know everything OratioViva can do. Paste your text, choose a voice, and click Generate. Happy listening!

safeguards.voiceRefNotSupported: The selected model doesn't use voice reference files. This field is for voice cloning models like SpeechT5 or XTTS.
safeguards.styleNotSupported: The selected model doesn't use style prompts. Style is built into the model itself.
safeguards.voicePromptNotSupported: The selected model doesn't use voice direction prompts. Select a different voice for different delivery styles.
